plist/parse#

Property lists read from XML or binary bytes.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let info = ParsedPlist(bytes).dictionary();
info.text("CFBundleIdentifier");
let root = ParsedPlist(bytes).root();          // any PlistValue

Description#

Property lists read from XML or binary bytes.

Both formats are detected. Input, node count and depth are bounded; InvalidPlist gives the byte offset of a problem.

Public API#

object ParsedPlist#

object ParsedPlist

A property list read from bytes.

ParsedPlist.ParsedPlist#

ParsedPlist(origin is @byte)

Reads origin within 1 MiB, 4096 nodes and depth 64.

ParsedPlist.dictionary#

dictionary() is PlistDictionary

The root as a dictionary, read like json (#141): ParsedPlist(bytes).dictionary().text("CFBundleIdentifier"). A root of another kind is PlistKindMismatch.

root() is PlistValue

The root value; InvalidPlist says where the bytes are wrong.
